about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Vigil of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, to draw new breath from the celebration of the birth of Thine Only-begotten Son, by Whose heavenly mystery we are fed and given drink. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
